anchor.quote: A method for joining components by means of tensioning bolts
placing a tensioning bolt at the components to be joined
threading a nut onto the tensioning bolt

stretching the tensioning bolt by means of a hydraulic tensioning device, supported at the components, said tensioning device being in engagement with the protruding end of the tensioning bolt which extends beyond the nut
turning the nut further until it contacts one of the components
the hydraulic pressure of the tensioning device is monitored
the tensioning device is blocked hydraulically when a hydraulic pressure target value is reached during stretching
in the event of a pressure drop during the blocking, pressure is built up again by additional pumping

at the beginning of the blocking a time measurement is started
a signal for turning the nut is generated if no pressure drop to below a lower threshold value occurs within a predetermined holding time after the start of the time measurement

an electronic recording of the following parameters is performed: a) the duration of the pressure build-up until the target value is reached, b) the magnitude of the pressure and/or the chronological development of the pressure, c) whether additional pumping has occurred
